question: Find the compound interest on ₹1,600 at 15% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We can calculate CI by the tree method

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2825cc1075b19d4dd888d5ab7ac4a1574e847cd614fa8ea4cb59bd71d8b9a69.png] 

CI = 240 + 240 + 36 = 516

∴ The required compound interest is ₹516.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Principal amount (P) = ₹1600

Number of years (T) = 2

Rate of interest (R) = 15%

Formula used:

Total amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

C.I = Total amount – Principal amount

Calculation:

A = 1600(1 + 15/100)2

⇒ A = 1600(1 + 3/20)2

⇒ A = 1600(23/20)2

⇒ A = 1600 × 529/400

⇒ A = 2116

C.I = 2116 – 1600

⇒ 516

**∴ The required compound interest is ₹516.**
